details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh:376-386 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The review_sweep_round_cap_applies exemption `and (($vw | not) or (.judge_merge_pending_state != "success"))` turns off the round-cap skip and the review_round_infra_backoff skip for every head with an `ai-review/judge-merge-pending` success, whatever its head-gate state; .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml lines 899-924 consume it.
  WHY: Heads whose head-gate is pending, absent or failure (lease-wait rows with the merge train off, lease-granted heads, later head-gate failures) are not caught by review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason, which handles only head_gate_state == "success". They are now dispatched on every sweep tick with no bound, which breaks the "round cap still bounds that path" constraint. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:949-968 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `final_ci_in_flight` verdict-wait skip sits inside the unrelated `SWEEP_SKIP_APPROVED_FINAL_CI_FAILED:-true != "false"` guard.
  WHY: With SWEEP_SKIP_APPROVED_FINAL_CI_FAILED=false and VERDICT_WAIT_DISPATCH_SKIP_ENABLED=true, an approved head whose final CI is running is re-reviewed on every tick, which goes against the README contract. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR; sonnet, gemini, luna and glm rated it NIT. The highest rating was used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:33270-33298 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `$latest` jq in _rb_judge_verdict_wait_check takes the max over every CheckRun completedAt and every non-`ai-review/` StatusContext createdAt, so the completion of any check counts as a relevant change, not only required checks.
  WHY: An unrelated or optional check, or the normal final CI, that finishes after the verdict makes `vw_g_latest > vw_g_vt`, and the judge is re-dispatched with reason=checks_changed. That goes against G2. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT (bounded extra runs); the others rated it MAJOR. The highest rating was used.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:499-511 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert, the once-per-head `ai-review/verdict-wait-alert` marker is posted with a bare `gh api -X POST`, without gh_retry, after the Telegram message has already been delivered.
  WHY: A transient POST failure leaves no marker, so the next tick sends the same WARNING again. That breaks G3 ("raised once per head, not once per tick"). Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR; the others rated it NIT. The highest rating was used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:933-958 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The verdict-wait skip runs before the approved_head_final_ci_failed block. An approved head with auto-merge enabled and a failed final CI is therefore logged as `reason=verdict_wait detail=auto_merge_waiting` instead of the documented `reason=approved_head_final_ci_failed`. Minimax traces this to review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason at scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh lines 420-426.
  WHY: Log consumers keyed on the stable token stop seeing these heads, and the skipped_approved_final_ci_failed counter undercounts. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR; sonnet, gemini and glm rated it NIT. The highest rating was used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:937-946 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new verdict-wait skip runs before the existing final-CI failure handling and does not check whether final CI failed.
  WHY: For an approved, mergeable head with auto-merge on and a failed final CI, dispatch is skipped as `auto_merge_waiting` before `SWEEP_SKIP_APPROVED_FINAL_CI_FAILED=false` can restore the documented re-review, which breaks the existing switch contract.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:33242-33395 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: _rb_judge_verdict_wait_check issues one GraphQL read per waiting PR from the stall loop (lines 33242-33256, called at 33393-33395), plus compare and files reads when the base moved. The reads are not batched across the cycle.
  WHY: N waiting PRs cost N extra reads per cycle, which goes against the issue's constraint that one more read is allowed only if it is unavoidable and batched. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT (net reduction versus dispatches); gemini, luna and glm rated it MAJOR. The highest rating was used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:33391-33401 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In _dispatch_rb_judge_for_pr, the verdict-wait check and its reads run before the free in-memory `phase_cap_can_dispatch` check.
  WHY: A PR that the cap defers (rc 3) still pays the GraphQL read, and possibly the compare and files reads, on every tick for nothing. All four flagging reviewers rated it NIT. openai_gpt-6-luna also raises this ordering inside its MAJOR per-PR-read finding above.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2062-2092 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: VERDICT_WAIT_DISPATCH_SKIP_ENABLED is not mapped into the env of the "Run standalone PR sweeps without active projects" step (lines 2057-2103). It is mapped at lines 1639 and 1906.
  WHY: Setting the repository variable to false does not restore judge dispatches on that path, because the code falls back to the `:-true` default. All three flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this as a false positive: the step sets STANDALONE_PR_SWEEP_ONLY=true, which skips the tracking loop and run_standalone_stall_recovery, so none of the _dispatch_rb_judge_for_pr call sites is reached.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:837-845 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:merge-lease-wait` skip still requires both MERGE_LEASE_ENABLED and merge_train_skip_active, and the new verdict-wait predicate does not handle that label.
  WHY: With merge-lease waiting on and the merge train inactive, an approved head carrying `ai:merge-lease-wait` falls through to dispatch and is re-reviewed every tick, which goes against G1.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:481-490 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In review_sweep_verdict_wait_alert, the case for `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` handles rc 0 and rc 1 but lets rc 2 (lookup failed) fall through to "unknown".
  WHY: The alert posts `blocker=unknown`, so a ruleset API error looks the same as "no blocker". anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna raised the same point as hardening suggestions only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Also run tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py and tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py," along with the listed focused acceptance tests (tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py, tests/test_stall_rb_judge_verdict_skip.py, tests/test_rb_judge_verdict_status.py, tests/test_review_sweep_round_cap.py)
  expected_change_site: PR verification / pre-push test gate run on the PR head for the listed test files
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description reports gate result `container_rc_137`, status "unverified", "Tests and checks run: 0" and every acceptance-test row "not run". No successful run of any required test appears in the CI context. The 480,000-byte guard on orchestrate_poll.yml and review_autofix_sweep.yml is therefore unverified, and the large orchestrate_poll_process.sh change has no executed test behind it. Gemini rated this BLOCKER; minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to report it as a gap, calling it a pipeline gate status rather than missing code and noting that the PR check runs show 0 failed.
- requirement: "G4. ... The round cap must not label a PR ai:needs-human when its current head already has a verdict; it stays in force for heads that are still not approved." / "Fail-open: ... The round cap still bounds that path."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml round-cap block (lines 899-924) and review_sweep_round_cap_applies in scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The diff removes the label but also removes the dispatch bound for judge-decided heads whose head-gate is not success, and no hunk keeps a dispatch skip for them.
- requirement: "Waiting states include: ... with a final CI run queued or running (ai:final-ci-merge-pending)." / "skip a head ... that carries ai:final-ci-merge-pending."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: Apart from the final_ci_merge_pending reason in review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason, the sweep enumeration loop has no explicit check that skips heads carrying the label. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes this, saying the label is handled in review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_sweep_round_cap.sh:review_sweep_round_cap_applies, the jq clause `and (($vw | not) or (.judge_merge_pending_state != "success"))`; used at .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml lines 899-905 to gate the round-cap block (lines 905-924) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The change turns off the review_round_cap skip (lines 907-913) and the review_round_infra_backoff skip (lines 920-922) for any head with a judge-merge-pending success, and nothing replaces them. Affected heads: judge-decided lease waiters whose head-gate is absent or pending while the merge train is off, and lease-granted heads whose head-gate is pending or failure.
  WHY: These heads are now dispatched every tick (about 30 minutes) with no limit, where before they were capped at SWEEP_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS (10). That breaks "the round cap still bounds that path". test_judge_decided_head_is_not_labelled_needs_human never checks dispatch. Suggested fix: keep the skip and the backoff, and use review_sweep_round_cap_applies only to gate review_sweep_round_cap_escalate.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:lines 949-967 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The final_ci_in_flight skip only runs while SWEEP_SKIP_APPROVED_FINAL_CI_FAILED is on, but the README ties it only to VERDICT_WAIT_DISPATCH_SKIP_ENABLED.
  WHY: With the old switch set to false, an approved head whose final CI is queued or running is re-reviewed every tick (the G1 case).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_rb_judge_verdict_wait_check, the `$latest` jq expression | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The completion of any check run counts as a change, including non-required checks and final CI, which finishes after head-gate success by design.
  WHY: In the #9984 pattern, the first stall check after CI returns reason=checks_changed and
